the_finding.reading: The Library already holds 39 of 40. The matching gids cluster around 29,000-30,000, which suggests both corpora came from the same Gutenberg science-fiction ingest. The IA "science fiction" pool largely MIRRORS what is already here.

what_this_invalidates: The proposal I escalated an hour ago said the subject filter yields "1,264 candidates". At a 97.5% overlap rate that is roughly 30 new books, not 1,264. The reduction from 270k was real; the assumption that what survived was NEW was never tested.
the_error: I validated the filter on three sample titles — Vulcan's Workshop, Wanderer of Infinity, Planet of Dreams — and reported them as evidence the filter worked. All three are ALREADY IN THE LIBRARY, at gids 29321, 29408 and 30045. I had the dedup tool half-written at the time and did not run it against my own examples.
a_measurement_error_i_caught: My first overlap run reported "154 checked" from 40 titles — shell word splitting had broken multi-word titles into separate arguments, so it was measuring fragments. The 16.9% it produced was meaningless. Re-ran passing titles as a proper argument list.
